cardArt.title: The American Express Velocity Platinum Card

product.description: The American Express Velocity Platinum Card has a suite of airline benefits including a complimentary domestic return flight on VA each year, travel insurance and earn Velocity Points with every dollar spent.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Long term visa means 12 months or more and does not include a student visa

features.additionalInfo: Add up to 4 Cards at no additional fee.
The Amex App lets you quickly and easily manage your Card Account anytime, anywhere.
Fraud Protection Guarantee, protecting you from unauthorised charges made on your Account.
A flexible way to pay off a selected amount or portion of your Credit Card balance in equal monthly instalments. Subject to fees.
Terms, conditions, cover limits and exclusions apply.
Card Purchase Cover, covering eligible items purchased with your Card
Up to 55 interest free days on purchases

2.25 Velocity Points on eligible Virgin Australia purchases per $1 spent.
1.25 Velocity Points on everyday purchases, except spend at government bodies in Australia where you'll get 0.5 Velocity Points per $1 spent.

Whether it's shopping, dining, travel or entertainment, eligible Card Members can access Amex Offers providing statement credits or bonus points. Amex Offers must be saved to the Card and used for qualifying spend, subject to offer-specific criteria, to receive a benefit.
Get pre-sale tickets and access to some of your favourite events, and enjoy the Amex Entertainment Lounge before the show at select venues. With Amex, you can dive into unforgettable experiences.

Complimentary return economy domestic Virgin Australia flight p.a. 
Receive an annual Complimentary Domestic Return Economy Flight on Virgin Australia between selected cities each anniversary year, subject to availability and eligibility criteria.
features.additionalValue: Complimentary Domestic Return Virgin Australia Flight

features.additionalInfo: Your American Express Velocity Platinum Card gives you access to Virgin Australia lounges at select domestic airports, every time you fly Virgin Australia domestically. Slip away from the crowds, sample an array of complimentary food and beverages, and take a load off before you take off. Enrolment in the VA Lounge Access benefit required. Subject to availability and eligibility criteria.

With Velocity, the frequent flyer program of Virgin Australia, you can earn and redeem your Velocity Points to travel to destinations around Australia. And when the time is right, you’ll be able to travel to your favourite locations overseas with Virgin Australia and Velocity’s international airline partners.

Each Membership year receive 2 complimentary Virgin Australia Guest Lounge Passes  to treat friends or family to VA Lounge access, when travelling with you on a domestic Virgin Australia flight, subject to availability and eligibility criteria.

Up to 100 Bonus Velocity Status Credits

Earn up to 100 Velocity Status Credits each year. Status Credits help you jump Velocity tier status and escape the crowds and skip the queues. Be awarded 50 Status Credits when you spend $25,000 on eligible purchases each Membership year and a further 50 Status Credits when you spend another $25,000 in the same Membership year.
